section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the five-step cross-cultural translation and adaptation of the CEMS and IES-2 into Brazilian Portuguese, following translation, synthesis, back-translation, expert committee review, and pre-testing. Two pre-tests are reported: an initial pre-test with ten participants (80% had difficulty with the CEMS 6-point scale) and a second pre-test with ten participants (50% men) after the CEMS scale was revised to five points.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Brazilian Portuguese translations of the CEMS and IES-2 were prepared according to the Institute for Work and Health's five-step (...) guidelines (...) The fifth step, pre-test, showed no particular difficulties with the IES-2, but of the ten recruited pre-test participants, 80% showed difficulties in responding to the CEM's original 6-point scale (...) A second pre-test with a new set of ten participants (50% men) was conducted; the revised response scale of the CEMS presented no difficulties for participants."
